Product Details: Powerful Cleaning, Convenient Design: This 1500-watt pressure washer delivers powerful cleaning performance. It features variable fan-jet and rotary nozzle, high-pressure foam application, and compact 5m hose storage for easy use and organization. The pump features three cylinders made of durable metal for reliable performance. Nozzles for Cleaning: The Bosch pressure washer comes equipped with versatile nozzles to tackle various cleaning tasks. The variable fan jet nozzle allows for adjustable spray patterns, ensuring precision for both delicate and tough surfaces. The rotary nozzle features an oscillating head that boosts cleaning power for stubborn grime, while the high-pressure foam nozzle, with a 450 ml capacity, enables the application of detergent for deep cleaning, perfect for cars and larger areas. Bosch Gun & Lance: The Bosch high pressure gun provides complete control over the cleaning process. With the trigger mechanism, users can easily regulate the flow of water and switch between different modes. The lance is an extension for the Bosch gun, designed to help users clean hard-to-reach areas without having to move the machine. Removing Heavy Dirt from Small Cars and Driveways: The Bosch pressure washer is ideal for removing heavy dirt from small cars and cleaning driveways. Its powerful water pressure effectively breaks down dirt, oil, and grime, providing a spotless finish and helping restore surfaces to their original condition. Safe Operation, Easy Setup: The BOSCH Easy Aquatak 120 is designed for water temperatures up to 40°C; using hotter water could cause damage. Quick and easy connections make setup convenient.
